footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Eledon: includes $3.3M from preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $83.3M from $70.6M.
The net loss widened to $42.3M, or −$0.52 per share, from $32.0M. Operating cash flow was −$62.3M and free cash flow −$62.3M, versus −$47.3M.
sources: Eledon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
